guest-ready-home-reset 1.0.1

- Updated acceptance documentation in ACCEPTANCE.md for greater clarity.
- No changes to skill functionality or user-facing workflow.
- Maintains focus on fast, practical home prep for guest visits.

guest-ready-home-reset 1.0.0

- Initial release of "Guest-Ready Home Reset": a prompt-only routine for fast, visible home prep before guests arrive.
- Provides a 60-minute reset plan, prioritized task zones, and quick task assignments (solo or with helpers).
- Includes supplies list, privacy and allergy prompts, guest essentials setup, and a fill-in welcome note template.
- Focuses on practical, high-impact guest preparation—no deep cleaning required.
- Safety boundaries and accessibility/allergy considerations included.
- Suitable for all guest types: social, family, overnight, service visits, and drop-ins.
